Name: Netorare Valley Pretty Anime Portraits
Author: Loki101idk
Description:
You will need APF Portrait Studio and Animated Portrait Framework and it's dependency's along with Pretty Anime Portraits -Dialogue Display Framework. (make sure it's the Dialogue Display framework.) 

*FILE SIZE WARNING* 4 GB for animated file, will have a single frame version soon which will be much smaller.

As said this is a bit of an experiment to see how APF Portrait Studio and Animated Portrait Framework works. This will be being worked on over time so expect that this will be improved over time. as of right now it's a bit wonky (Some animations look kind of weird and those that do will over time be replaced with better animations.) Also some animations may take a moment when they first play after that they should load smoothly. 

Plan 
I Plan on getting the backgrounds removed (any that aren't removed as of right now are not due to parts of the character being removed as well so they will need to be done manually.) and making animations smoother and more accurate (for example some of the blowjob animations have the girls doing this weird circle headbob thing, this is getting redone over time.) these animations cost money to redo so they will only get improved when I have extra money and feel like using it for this mod. 

Warning for femaleSex events I could not for the life of me get the 69 event portrait to work, every prompt I tried ended in a monstrosity (Also don't use the prompt eating out AI believes that to mean something completely different) so please be patient as I'm still trying to find a way to get this to work. 



I want to give a thank you to 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SerDakota]SerDakota[/url] for making the Pretty Anime Portrait (I know its AI but I honestly like the characters look in this.)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TrashRacc1124]TrashRacc1124[/url] for making Valley girl (None of this would be possible with their mod.)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tyr4nTX]Tyr4nTX[/url] for making APF Portrait Studio and Animated Portrait Framework (Honestly pretty awesome framework.
